Test fixtures.

- `opera_game.pgn` — Morphy vs Duke Karl / Count Isouard, Paris 1858 (public domain).
- `puzzles_sample.csv` — a small sample of the [lichess puzzle database](https://database.lichess.org/#puzzles)

  `scripts/eval_motifs.py`.
